identities_detail.blocker: The only positive primary outcome used a single 12 g challenge and the one label-range trial (1,000 mg/day) was null; catalog median is 60 mg/day. The scorer's dose handling (min_clinical_dose guard) cannot express 'positive only far above any label serving'.

identities_detail.proposal: HOLD — do not create a scoring record in Wave 1
identities_detail.outcome: still held — no matcher change addresses this blocker
identities_detail.blocker: Positive and mixed results are population- and indication-specific (IVF/diminished ovarian reserve, adrenal insufficiency, clinical depression, and a women-only bone-density signal in healthy older adults), and no review states a dose. With no population or sex gate the record would credit 25 mg consumer products. Hormone-related, so it also routes to the high-risk path.

identities_detail.blocker: Evidence is gram-level supplementation or whole-diet substitution against surrogate endpoints; the scorer has no exposure-basis concept, so dietary-substitution trials would become capsule efficacy at a 20-40x dose gap.
